    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Vehicle vehicle)
      Compares this vehicle to another by license plate. Returns a negative value if this plate comes before the other, a positive value if it comes after, and a 0 if they are the same.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Vehicle>
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to compare with
      Returns:
      -1, 0, or 1 depending on the order of the license plates.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      Determines if this vehicle is equal to another object. Vehicles are considered equal if they have the same license plate, regardless of make, date obtained, or mileage.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      obj - the object to compare
      Returns:
